name: ilc-sourcepoint-pay-or-ok
comment: Sourcepoint 'consent or pay' walls (e.g. spiegel.de, zeit.de, bild.de, theguardian.com). autoconsent's Sourcepoint-frame deliberately ignores them (opt-out is impossible there). We click the free 'accept all' choice (type 11). The paid / subscription choice (type 9) is never clicked. Some sites render each button twice (desktop + mobile), one of them hidden.
